title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Anthropic API
providers.scope_notes: Covers Anthropic Claude API (Claude Console / Claude Platform). Claude Console organizations on platform.claude.com; Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) compliance keys and App Attest device tokens are noted but not catalogued as paths.

controls.name: Remove user / archive service account
controls.what: Personal keys stop on user removal; service account keys stop on account archive.

controls.name: Compliance API (Activity Feed)
controls.what: Must be on for key and federation activity to be recorded.
controls.setting: Claude Console > Settings > Security > Compliance API
controls.plan: Eligible organizations (self-service) or via account team

controls_unknown: Customer IP allowlisting for Claude API requests (not found in docs).
Whether keys or OAuth tokens are subject to SSO / IdP conditional access.
Whether disabling a key or archiving a rule ends already-minted WIF tokens immediately.
Lifetime and admin revocation of ant CLI OAuth tokens.
Console UI path for the maximum expiration policy and the member API key creation setting.
Whether Messages API calls generate Activity Feed events (feed excludes prompt/response text).

authentication.summary: Workload exchanges an IdP JWT at POST /v1/oauth/token for a short-lived token acting as a service account, per a federation rule.

federation.details: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and standards-compliant OIDC issuers (GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, SPIFFE, Entra ID, Okta).

ip_restriction.boundary: No customer IP allowlist for Claude API requests found in fetched docs; the IP addresses page only lists Anthropic's own ranges.

lifetime.summary: Rule token_lifetime_seconds 60-86400, capped by 2x remaining IdP JWT lifetime

administration.summary: Issuers, rules and service accounts are managed in Console or via Admin API endpoints that accept only an org:admin OAuth token. Archiving a rule blocks new exchanges.
administration.conditions: Issuer sets maximum accepted IdP token lifetime (1h default).

sso.details: Token issuance depends on a JWT from your own IdP, so IdP controls such as conditional access apply at exchange time; org SSO/MFA does not apply to the minted token.

offboard.details: Tokens act as a service account, not a user.

inventory.details: Admins can list service accounts, federation issuers and federation rules via the Admin API list endpoints, but not individual minted tokens.

inventory.cli: ant organization:service-accounts list; ant organization:federation:issuers list; ant organization:federation:rules list --issuer-id <fdis_id>

sso.ui: Console > Workload identity > rule match conditions (subject_prefix, audience, claims, CEL condition); conditional access is set in your IdP

expiry.ui: Console > Workload identity > Connect workload (wizard sets token_lifetime_seconds, default 600)

reads.api: GET /v1/compliance/activities?activity_types[]=platform_file_content_downloaded; match actor.api_key_id client-side (actor_ids[] accepts only user_ IDs)

token_format.notes: Short-lived access token; format not documented

log_sources.name: Compliance API Activity Feed (GET /v1/compliance/activities)
log_sources.notes: Must be enabled; 6-year retention; not retroactive. Admin API keys can read it.

log_sources.name: Usage and Cost API
log_sources.notes: Aggregated usage filterable by API key.

credential_id_fields.notes: Actor attribution for WIF calls not verified

containment.steps: Archive the federation rule (then issuer/service account).
containment.notes: Archiving a federation rule stops new exchanges immediately, but tokens already minted stay valid until they expire (default 3600s, max 86400s).
